d.ko:
Discover the truth about Quern’s past, unfold the mysteries of its present, and be the explorer who shapes its future. 

Quern introduces reusable puzzle mechanics to the classic genre, making the player think about the game as a whole, and not just as a series of individual challenges.

d.zh:
探索 Quern 过往的真相、解开其当代的谜题并成为改变未来的探索家。

Quern 将可反复用使用的谜题机制融入传统谜题游戏之中，让玩家们能够融汇整款游戏中的谜题而非进行一道道毫无关联的挑战。

The first game I've ever played with my wife. 12 Years of marriange and I have never found a game that's held her interest for more than 5 minutes, now we're 13 hours in and it's the greatest experience of all time

Absolutely fantastic (except that simon says puzzle). Clever and fun puzzles (except that simon says puzzle), challenge level is just right (except that simon says puzzle), i got stuck a couple of times but was always able to figure it out …
Some parts are confusing and running back and forth was driving me up the wall, a game for others but not for me
十一小时通关，难度较高的长篇开放式解密。如果你是偏硬核的解密爱好者，那不妨尝尝鲜。不推荐只是想要玩类似于锈湖的简易解密玩家，可能会过于冗长和困难
游戏很不错流程很长很有意思 不过没有指引与提示容易卡关 需要多观察环境
出了新手教程之后完全不知道要干嘛。半个小时一直在那个地图里乱窜。。讨厌这种开放世界（或者半开放世界或者其他什么类型的世界。），比起同厂商的达芬奇密码，实在是太差了。。 算了，这个游戏发售时间比达芬奇系列的第一部还要早。 …
